title.zh: 社区纠纷解决（出庭通知）条例 2025
title.en: Community Disputes Resolution (Notice to Attend Court) Regulations 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Community Disputes Resolution (Notice to Attend Court) Regulations 2025 and come into operation on 7 April 2025.
2. A notice served on a person to attend court under section 13T of the Act must be in the form set out in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
Regulation 2
NOTICE TO ATTEND COURT
(SECTION 13T(1) OF THE COMMUNITY DISPUTES
RESOLUTION ACT 2015)
Case Reference Number:
Court Reference Number:
[Respondent’s full name]
[Respondent’s address]
You are required to answer to the charge of:
[state the offence],
of the Community Disputes Resolution Act 2015,
in person before the State Courts No. [state court number], located at 1 Havelock Square, Singapore 059724 on [state date] at [state time].
If you do not have a valid excuse, neglect or refuse to appear on the abovementioned date and time, a warrant to arrest you may be issued.
[Name and signature of authorised officer]
[Designation of authorised officer]
Community Relations Unit
Municipal Services Office
Ministry of National Development
Date of issue:
Received by:
Interpreted using [language] (if any) by:
__________________
(Signature)
__________________
(Signature)
[Name of Respondent]
[Name of interpreter]
